e.title: Ergodic Insurance Limits
e.summary: 遍历经济学保险优化（PyPI，GPL-3.0）：从长期复合增长而非期望值视角找最优保险结构（自留/限额/分层）
e.summary_en: Ergodic economics insurance optimisation (PyPI, GPL-3.0): optimal insurance structure (retention/limits/layers) from long-term compound growth, not expected value
e.summary_hk: 遍歷經濟學保險優化（PyPI，GPL-3.0）：從長期複合增長而非期望值視角找最優保險結構（自留/限額/分層）
e.body:
Ergodic Insurance Limits（AlexFiliakov，PyPI ergodic-insurance，GPL-3.0）把遍历经济学（ergodicity economics，Ole Peters 2019）应用于保险优化：传统分析问「期望回收是否超过保费」，本框架问「哪个保险结构最大化公司长期复合增长」——答案常出人意料（解释了为何成熟买家愿付远超期望损失的保费）。对 RIAA：新兴研究方向的 Python 实现——[[rim540]] 破产理论/几何收益的延伸：波动税（volatility tax）让大额损失比期望值暗示的更伤长期增长；自留/限额/分层的优化从时间平均（time average）而非集合平均出发；9★ 但 PyPI 发布 + 研究前沿 + 2026-06 活跃；适合对精算基础理论创新感兴趣的学生。

## 同类工具
[[extreme-stats-jl]]、[[forvis-modelling-revolution]]、[[fp198-dl-ldi]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
Ergodic Insurance Limits (AlexFiliakov, PyPI ergodic-insurance, GPL-3.0) applies ergodicity economics (Ole Peters, 2019) to insurance optimisation: traditional analysis asks 'does expected recovery exceed the premium', this framework asks 'which insurance structure maximises a company's long-term compound growth' — with surprisingly different answers (explaining why sophisticated buyers pay premiums well above expected losses). For RIAA: a Python implementation of an emerging research direction — extending [[rim540]] ruin theory/geometric returns: the volatility tax makes large losses more damaging to long-term growth than expected value suggests; retention/limit/layer optimisation from the time average rather than the ensemble average; 9★ but PyPI-published + research frontier + active 2026-06; suits students interested in foundational actuarial innovation.

e.body_hk:
Ergodic Insurance Limits（AlexFiliakov，PyPI ergodic-insurance，GPL-3.0）把遍歷經濟學（ergodicity economics，Ole Peters 2019）應用於保險優化：傳統分析問「期望回收是否超過保費」，本框架問「哪個保險結構最大化公司長期複合增長」——答案常出人意料（解釋了為何成熟買家願付遠超期望損失的保費）。對 RIAA：新興研究方向的 Python 實現——[[rim540]] 破產理論/幾何收益的延伸：波動稅（volatility tax）讓大額損失比期望值暗示的更傷長期增長；自留/限額/分層的優化從時間平均（time average）而非集合平均出發；9★ 但 PyPI 發佈 + 研究前沿 + 2026-06 活躍；適合對精算基礎理論創新感興趣的學生。
